bias.en: Neutral · pullback onto the 30 and 100-day averages
bias.zh: 中性 · 回调至 30 日与 100 日均线

read.en: Teradyne fell 4.7% on Oct 12 to $383.85, down 14% in five sessions. The day's low of $381.83 landed exactly on the 30 and 100-day averages ($381.8), with the 200-day ($342) rising below. It is under the 5 and 10-day averages ($405–414). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 12, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8, and RSI is 47.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月12日下跌 4.7%，收于 $383.85，五个交易日下跌 14%。当日低点 $381.83 恰好落在 30 日和 100 日均线（$381.8）上，下方 200 日均线（$342）向上。股价位于 5 日和 10 日均线（$405–414）下方。MACD 于 10月12日下穿信号线，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空，RSI 为 47。

read.en: The $382 band is the key test; a close below it points to the 200-day near $342, then $326 (September lows). The $389 support from the last read is now first resistance, then $405–414 (5 and 10-day averages, Oct 9 high) and $444–452.
read.zh: $382 区域为关键测试；若收盘跌破，下看约 $342 的 200 日均线，再看 $326（9月低点）。上次解读中的 $389 支撑现为第一阻力，其次 $405–414（5 日和 10 日均线、10月9日高点）及 $444–452。
